summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a 6-K reporting board approval to acquire all shares of Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Óptica S.A. held by Telefônica Infra, S.L. Unipersonal, representing 24.99% of FiBrasil's capital, for R$ 458,719,774.51. The acquisition is supported by an independent valuation. Upon closing, Telefônica Brasil will hold 100% of FiBrasil. The transaction is exempt from CADE approval and does not require prior ANATEL authorization. Payment is a single installment at execution. Two board members abstained. Watch for SPA execution and any minority challenges.
